nom: Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte's Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser

avis.titre: I would not buy this product again
avis.texte: I absolutely love all of Charlotte Tilbury face care products, except this cleanser. It is very harsh my skin started burning as soon as I started rubbing it in my cheeks. It almost felt like I had small cuts on my skin or something. I left it for about another minute to see if the burning subsided, but it only got worse. I will admit it deeply, deeply cleans your face and strips it of any oils as well which I didn't like. My face was left tight as a drum, red as a beet and the next day I broke out (mind you I never have acne) I had pimples all on my cheeks. All in all it was way too harsh for my skin.
Loved the creamy texture that lathers into a gentle foam! Skin feels hydrated & soft, no tightness. Nice scent too!. Great packaging, not exactly whatI was expecting but its ok

Ooooh this stuff is exactly what a toy is to a kid, for an adult! Luxury in a bottle! The smoothest, cleanest, perfectly enhanced cleanser! Now that my excitement is out of the bag, I'd like to just rave on how wonderful this cream to foam to milk cleanser is! It goes on nice and thin as the cream part, you massage it into your skin and watch it magically turn to a foamy kind of wash, continue massaging and then it becomes a kind of thick milky texture. As the consistency's change, you can feel how each layer does something different. It's like, at first you are prepping for a clean.. and then it goes to actually cleaning, and finishes with a moisturizing and hydrating touch.
I love the way this moisturizer made my skin feel! I jave sensitive skin so I was a bit nervous to try. My skin ended up lovinf this moisturizer. I will definitely repurchase soon!

Okay, so, I do think it is much more hydrating than any other cleanser I've tried. I love the texture/consistency; it's super creamy. The smell is a little weird - it kind of reminds me of old-school Olay or something. But my main gripe is that it BURNS!!! It burns like a chemical peel! For face wash?? WHY?!?! That part is so off-putting, because I just don't understand why or how a hydrating cleanser burns like an acid?? TL;DR: It works, but weirdly stings.
I like how this felt on my skin during application and after washing off! Didn't make it feel tight or dry, just super soft and sorta supple?! It lathers up well and a little goes a long way.

I am absolutely IN LOVE with my Charlotte Tilbury Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser ! It completely removes all of my makeup and leaves my skin feeling so clean and hydrated. I keep it in my skincare fridge, which makes it feel wonderful on my skin. I can definitely say my skin looks more glowy and radiant after using it for the last 30 days! I will definitely continue using this!

avis.titre: Must have for dry, sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I have sensitive, dry skin with rosacea, and this was truly gentle on my skin! I didn't notice any irritation and my skin felt so soft and clean. I paired it with the magic cream and I'm obsessed with how nice and plump my skin looks afterwards!

I've used plain ole beauty bar as my face wash for years! I am always nervous to try something new, will I break out? Will it dry my face? Charlotte's magic hydration has been great! Washes away all makeup and leaves my face feeling so soft and clean.

After using this product for weeks I am obsessed with how plump and smooth my skin is looking! It keeps my skin really hydrated which I love because hydrated skin helps prevent those wrinkles! It also contains amazing benefits good for sensitive skin! Thank you so much Influenster for this product my skin loved it ! I loved the packaging it's super sleek and clean !! ❤️
Perfect cleanser for my face. Would recommend to friends and family. Now one of my go to for my new fave routine! Big packaging and can last a long time
I love this!! You get so much product and it works really well!! I've been using it every morning and my skin has been loving it!! Would definitely recommend trying it

I am loving the results of this product my skin looks more moisturized and hydrated then before. It helps cleanse the face of makeup and any outside pollution on the skin. Help my skin looks better than before. I have dry skin spots and this help my face start to clear up those dry spots.

This is a nice, soft and smooth feeling cleanser. I did not feel that it stripped my skin as other cleansers do. My main qualm (which did not affect the rating is that I wish there was more control of how much product comes out of the tube. Everytime I use this, a ton comes out.

I didn't know if this would be much different than most facial cleaners but I was wrong. This Charlotte Tilbury Magic Revival Foaming Gentle Cleanser with Hyaluronic Acid is so good! It makes my skin feel so clean and soft! Doesn't really have much of a scent and is non irritating to my skin but you can feel a little tingling that makes you know it's working! The packaging is so nice and fancy for a facial cleanser. It is a bit pricey but definitely worth it!
With a few uses of the Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser, I noticed that my face started looking brighter and more hydrated. In addition, my face felt very clean.

I definitely am replacing my old face wash with this cleanser! My skin had never looked better! It gets my skin super clean and removes more of my makeup than other brands do. It doesn't leave my face feeling tight or dried out either which I love

I ran out of my normal face wash, and this came at the right time. You have to use a lot of product to really feel clean which I feel is sort of a waste. It's a good alternative when I'm out of my normal face wash, but I will not be purchasing it as there are better products out there. ￼
I wasn't a huge fan of this. I tried all tge "uses" or ways to apply and wasn't impressed with any of them. Face doesn't feel hydrated, but kind of dry.

Very good at removing makeup and my face feels clean and not dried out after I use it. I hate cleansers that make me feel More dry and this one doesn't do that. I like that it turns into a milk like texture. Little to no scent
I absolutely love this facial cleanser by Charlotte Tilbury. It works really well to clean my face. I would highly recommend on my family and friends.

Charlotte Tilbury✨ . I received the opportunity to test the Charlotte Tilbury magic cream & hydration revival cleanser. The hydration revival cleanser is a creamy formula that removes makeup while also keeping the skin hydrated in the process. I really enjoy using both of these during the winter months since my skin gets dehydrated from cleansing. They're a great combo product to use and I would highly recommend checking them out!

I'm thrilled with the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Revival Foaming Gentle Cleanser with Hyaluronic Acid! This cleanser has become my skin's new best friend, gently lifting away dirt and impurities while nourishing my skin with hyaluronic acid. The texture is a delight - a rich, creamy lather that feels like a spa treatment in a bottle. The formula is pigment-free, so it doesn't leave any residue or affect my skin tone. And the scent? Ah, the scent is pure bliss! A soft, calming aroma that's like a breath of fresh air for my senses. My skin feels refreshed, renewed, and hydrated after every use. It's the perfect way to start and end my day, and I love how it sets my skin up for success with the rest of my skincare routine. Charlotte Tilbury has knocked it out of the park with this one - it's a true game-changer for gentle, effective cleansing!"
This prod ur doesn't feel like it's doing my when I allot it but once I wash it off my face feels so clean and refreshed! I love using this product and having my face feel clean and smooth!

This cleanser was fantastic. Very little scent with a fantastic texture and great lather. My skin felt really clean with no drying. Still felt clean and fresh the next morning when I used this at night before bed.
This cleanser is very refreshing. I feel like it does a good job of getting my face clean and there's not a strong scent so that's good also. It's a super soft cleanser.
This is my all time favorite facial cleanser! It has drastically shrunk my pores. Something I never thought could be done! The smell is wonderful and I can't wait to grab more when I run out!

I absolutely love this face wash and I love that it's made in Switzerland. The scent is light and reminds me of a scent of something ive had before but I just can't place it. The scent isn't heavy and its light and lovely. You only need a small amount of this to wash your face and it's super creamy. It makes your skin feel so soft after washing and lathers amazingly. I don't have one bad thing to say about this face wash. I would definitely buy this.

If I'm being honest, this is not my favorite facial cleanser. It does the job, but the consistency feels more like lotion then face wash and that's weird to me. It's a little pricy so I would rather buy a less expensive product for something like a face wash. It does clean the skin well and isn't super harsh, so there is that benefit to it. Overall just average for me.

A foamy cleanser that effectively removes all my makeup and is gentle on my skin. It leaves my skin glowy and radiant. I didnt experience any breakouts and I have pretty snesitive skin. Would definitely repurchase.
This cleanser is amazing. It does not dry out my skin, is gentle, and leaves a smooth & clean feeling behind after use. My skin feels rejuvenated after each use!

Thanks for @Influenster and @CharlotteTilbury for sending me this complimentary product in exchange for my honest review. It's absolutely luxurious! This high-end cleanser leaves my skin feeling incredibly refreshed and nourished. The scent is clean and fresh. It's gentle formula effortlessly removes impurities, leaving behind a radiant glow. A must-have for anyone seeking top-tier skincare.

Very effective at removing my makeup. I will use this product as a second cleanser when I feel my micellar water has not taken off all of my makeup. Not the most gentle milky cleanser and I wish it did not include fragrance. Left my skin more stripped than expected
My new favorite! great foamy action but gentle in the skin. A little goes a long way. Leaves my skin radiant and glowy not drying at all which I love! I will repurchase

avis.titre: Replaces your makeup remover, cleanser and facewash
avis.texte: This is a really amazing cleanser/ facewash. Normally I use makeup remover, then cleanse then wash my face that is 3 steps and 3 products. With this product you use it as a cream cleanser and it removes makeup, setting spray, waterproof mascara with little effort, once the makeups rubbed off just add a little water and it foams and becomes a facewash. I am so glad I got this.

A gentle cleanser that effectively removes all my makeup and leaves my skin leaving soft like a baby's but? Yes, please! This cleanser is an amazing. The bottle is a nice sized bottle and a little product goes a long way. It lathers nicely and feels good on the skin. Most importantly, it's effective!

I loveeee this cleanser, I feel like I noticed a difference in my skin with the first use. My skin felt cleaner and noticed a difference in my pores. The cleanser doesn't have any scent. I would definitely recommend this to my family and friends
I have been using this every night. It feels so amazing and smooth. I love the hydrating feel.my skin has and will definitely want to continue using it. So glad I got the opportunity to try this

This worked for me, I have seborrheic dermatitis and sensitive skin, this cleanser didn't break me out or agrivate my skin condition. It was very moisturizing and worked very well with the moisturizer, it does have a fragrance but it was nice and it didn't get overwhelming. I used it to remove makeup and it worked without stripping the skin. I'm still currently using it even though I ran out of the moisturizer, it worked out with other skin care products.

Love the texture so much!! Very smooth, easy to clean and doesn't make your skin feel weird. Love that it contains hyaluronic acid. I have been using it everyday and love it so much! The smell is good and lovely packaging.

This was my first time using this cleanser and i really liked it. It felt hydrating and didnt dry me out, even after using it everyday this week. It does pretty well removing my makeup. I havnt experienced any break outs and its easy to wash off.

avis.titre: Such a nice texture but wish it was larger.
avis.texte: I've been trying out the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser and honestly, it's a hit for me. The texture is so nice - really smooth and luxurious, making washing my face feel a bit more special. What I really love is how well it takes off my makeup. It's quick, clean, and leaves my skin feeling great - not dry or like I've still got product on my face. It's a huge plus because I've struggled with other cleansers leaving my skin feeling either too oily or too dry. But, there's a catch. The size of the product just doesn't match up with the price. I noticed I was running out of it way faster than I expected, which is a bit of a bummer considering how much it costs. It's a great product, but it feels like I'd be buying a new one all the time, which adds up. Overall, the Charlotte Tilbury Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser is great if you're looking for something that feels luxurious and does the job. Just keep in mind it might be a bit of an investment if you plan to use it regularly.

I really liked this cleanser. It lathered easily, cleaned well, and didn't leave any residue when rinsed off. A good sized bottle too. The scent isn't my favorite (smells sort of like the soap at a dr's office), but I can get past that.
Totally recommended, after using it your skin feels soft, clean, fresh and with less noticeable pores.

I've been using this face cleanser for a couple weeks now and it's been amazing. It gets my face nice and clean without drying my face out. It also doesn't make me break out unlike other cleansers I've used and I feel like it cleans all the makeup, dirt and oil off my face. I haven't noticed much of a smell if there even is one.
Seems to work very well if I can get to a nice foamy texture it makes it feel clean and soft but if not then it just feel like a weird film on my face so a pain

I absolutely do not like this cleanser. First, it's way too perfume-y. Second, it doesn't lather very well. Third, it made my skin feel almost waxy???! It also made my face feel like it was burning after I used it once. That sensation lasted about an hour. They're are WAY better cleansers out there than this one. Don't recommend Charlotte's Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser.
This cleanser is gentle on my skin and keep it clean without stripping it. My skin feels soft and hydrated after using this gel cleanser. It foams easily and washes off with warm water.

Overall, I feel like this product is working very well. The texture of the product is nice and creamy and I like the ingredients of hydrologic acid. The scent is nice and clean in the packaging is super cute.

I love this! This cleanser truly leaves me super radiant and gives my skin a smooth satin feel! The hyaluronic acid keeps my skin hydrated and plump! It's unscented which is amazing for my sensitive skin! The packaging is also perfect and really pretty!

This face wash feels great when applying and rubbing into my skin. I definitely feel more moisturized and clean. The only reason I took away a star is I'm not in love with the scent. But the benifits of the wash definitely out weigh the negative of the smell.

Awesome cleanser! Leaves skin very clean but not dry -instead very very moisturized and smooth. It has a pleasant scent I will purchase again. I received this product for free in return for my honest opinion.

This is a really nice and gentle cleanser which my dry skin loves! It has mild lathering effect into a creamy/milky consistency and washes off nicely without leaving the skin feeling stripped and dry. If you like something that is more foamy and lathery I don't think you'd enjoy it but for any of those folks with dry or sensitive skin this is a great cleanser for mornings or as a second cleanser.

l received this product in exchange for my honest review. I really liked using this cleanser. I'm not a huge fan of the light scent but it wouldn't stop me from using it. I have combo skin and it made the dry bits moisturized and the greasy areas more normal. I felt the cleanser was gentle and made my skin better. I'd recommend for any skin type!

Love Charlotte Tilbury, but this cleanser wasn't for me. I love the packaging, the scent and texture were good and formula was not stripping or drying, however I found that this gentle formula required too much effort to remove makeup. As a cleanser that is a minimum requirement. I have to use a lot of product to get a good cleaning, and I always have to go in 2x. For the price this should cleanse better. Can't wait to try more from the brand but this wasn't enough cleanser for me
I've been using this cleanser in my AM routine and I love it! No bad smell, it gets all the crud off, feels velvety on my skin! The squeeze bottle helps me not waste product.

I received Charlotte Tilbury Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser free to try for my honest opinion. This is a 3 in 1 face wash that hydrates, revives & primes the skin. I absolutely love it. It removes my makeup really well. My skin feels so soft & hydrated after using this product. I absolutely will continue to purchase & use this. I have replaced my old cleanser with it!

I had a generally positive experience with this. The texture is luxurious, and it lathers nicely, providing a satisfying cleansing experience. Post use, my skin feels refreshed and clean without any tightness or dryness. However, given the steep price tag, I was expecting more significant improvements in my skin's appearance over time, which I didn't quite observe. While I enjoyed using it, I'm hesitant to repurchase due to the high cost and the lack of visible long term benefits for my skin.
The scent was lightly floral which I wasn't expecting but it was very subtle so I didn't mind. It made my skin feel hydrated after the cleanse which usually it feels stripped and dry.
I love this cleanser it's really good at removing all make up and it left my skin feeling very clean and even got off stubborn glitter. This is a staple now

This cleanser is great if you're lacking a bit of moisture in your skin. I do the double cleanse method. So I use this cleanser as my first wash and it removes all my makeup effortlessly. You get a great amount product and a little bit goes a very long way.
I like it a lot , cleans so well your skin after a whole day using makeup and leaves your skin hydrated and soft . It doesn't have a bad scent too. Natural

avis.titre: Not for everyone but worth it !
avis.texte: I have received this product complementary from Influenster and brands in exchange of my honest review - Charlotte's Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser is a gentle and hydrating cleanser that effectively removes impurities without stripping the skin. It has a smooth, creamy texture and creates a rich foam when lathered with water. The cleanser leaves the skin feeling refreshed, nourished, and hydrated. The mild scent adds a luxurious touch. While not suitable for extremely sensitive or acne-prone skin, it delivers clean and balanced results with improved skin texture.

This was an excellent nighttime cleanser. It has a great foaming texture which I like, while leaving my skin smooth and free of makeup/dirt. I didn't mind the scent, but there was a slight scent to it. It didn't dry out my face or cause any irritation which was a plus. I definitely like this as a daily cleanser.
The magic hydration face cleanser works great to remove makeup and reduce pores without leaving your skin feeling dry & tight thanks to the hyaluronic acid and skin smoothing peptide complex.
Really rich feeling face cleanser it's creamy and hydrating without drying and stripping the skin it's high quality and no irritation after using this

This face wash has a floral scent that unfortunately is very unappealing to me. Luckily, the scent goes away pretty quickly. This cleanser is gentle and non-drying but I did notice that when I tried to use it to remove all of my makeup, including my eye makeup, it irritated my eyes. The packaging is OK but for the price point I would expect something a little more expensive looking. Unfortunately, I think there are better options available at a similar or even lower price point.
Love the feeling of this cleanser. It makes it feel so soft like velvet. It does have a little bit of a strange scent but is definitely worth it for silky smooth skin.

After using this cleanser for a few weeks it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. I tend to have dryer skin especially in the winter so this cleanser not only cleansed my skin well but left it feeling hydrated too.

Love this face wash, I use this before putting on my makeup. I received this for free for testing but had my eye on this for a while so very happy with this on needless to say. Didn't feel heavy on my face and didn't break me out which is important to me when testing new face skincare!

This is a great cleanser. I did feel like it is a bit thick and sticky, but the scent was lovely! I feel like it is a good cleanser for both morning and night, and will leave your skin glowing and smooth. 4 stars only because of the price.

Ooooh this stuff is exactly what a toy is to a kid, for an adult! Luxury in a bottle! The smoothest, cleanest, perfectly enhanced cleanser! Now that my excitement is out of the bag, I'd like to just rave on how wonderful this cream to foam to milk cleanser is! It goes on nice and thin as the cream part, you massage it into your skin and watch it magically turn to a foamy kind of wash, continue massaging and then it becomes a kind of thick milky texture. As the consistency's change, you can feel how each layer does something different. It's like, at first you are prepping for a clean.. and then it goes to actually cleaning, and finishes with a moisturizing and hydrating touch. At the end, your skin is plumped up, glowing, and oh so smooth! It even smells clean.. with maybe a faint hint of roses. It has no problems removing all the makeup and pollution, and left my skin feeling and looking way better than it did at the start! Some additional pros for using this includes how it makes your pores look reduced, and leaves a glow in its place. The longer you use this product, the better your skin looks and feels! You use this in the AM and the PM, you just apply and rinse with warm water. That's it, that's all for the most beautiful skin you could possibly have! Definitely give this a try and prepare to be amazed!
This is now my go to face wash! It gently cleanses, it's not too frothy but is effective. It doesn't have a scent. The packaging is nice and this was a generous sample.

I used charlotte tilbury magic face cream in conjunction with the CT face wash. They worked good together in tandem. The CT items are definitely overpriced in my opinion. I do like this face wash, it smells nice, and leaves my face feeling smooth and fresh. It is gentle but cleans at same time. I always wash my face by combining cleanser and a cellulose sponge.

I like the formula it starts as a cream base, to a foam and ends as a milk hydrating cleanser. Is designed to cleanse, hydrate and leave glowy the skin, claims to reduce pores visibly and it does, my skin was really bright, smooth and with a beautiful glow as well is good to remove the make up. Is safe for morning and night routine and it works better with warm water to make the magic of this soap do the trick. Great reinforcement for the skin barrier. What I noticed instantly was my skin was bright and glowing, the pores slightly erase of course with the time it improved drastically ( I took my time using it to make a fair use of the product and make my review).

**I received this product for free, in exchange for an honest review.** It's almost as if the skincare gods knew exactly what I needed. My skin generally gets super dry during the colder months and I religiously wash my face and sometimes forget to moisturize (don't hate me). My usual cleanser that I get from my esthetician is great, but is a bit drying (it is a gel cleanser). The Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser definitely left my face NOT dry after cleansing my face with it. It's a decent-sized tube that should last quite a while - a little should go a long way. It's very soft and sulky as far as a "cream" cleanser goes. I will continue to use this as a secondary cleanser. The only thing that I don't love and would probably deduct 1/2 a star for is the scent. It's not a BAD scent - it's actually either unsent or very faintly scented - but something in the formula has a slightly medicinal smell and my sensitive nose doesn't love it. It's bearable to use, though. Overall, 4.5/5 stars. Great supplemental cleanser for any routine for someone with dry skin concerns.
I loved this cleanser. I have tried several other ones and my skin ended up feeling very dry afterwards but not with this one! I line the consistency too.

Skin looks fresher and better after using this cleanser several times. the skin is fresh, not tight, the tone is improved and I see the pores have become less enlarged. The skin is very hydrated after using the product. excellent ingredients and texture for healthy skin, convenient packaging and delicate aroma.

I love this cleanser! You can use it multiple ways, cream, foam or milk. I've noticed such an improvement to my skin since I started using it. Fantastic ingredients to keep your skin feeling amazing! Absolutely love!

When I saw that this was a hydrating cleanser I was very excited to try. You can feel the hydration as soon as you squeeze it out the tube it's on your skin. It gives you a nice lather almost like a cleansing balm. I love that it is removing make up as I'm cleansing, and though I multi cleanse I don't feel like it's completely necessary. It leaves your skin feeling lovely prior to following it up with a moisturizer. ￼

This is a decent cleanser that starts out creamy, but works into a lovely foam. Even though it says it suited for dry to combination skin, I do feel it has more heaviness to it, therefore leaning more towards dry skin. I think it works well when using as part of a double cleanse routine or an at the end of the day without makeup. I'm not sure I would trust it to remove all my make up. The scent is actually quite nice, and the packaging is so luxe.
The absolute best cleanser on the market. It does not leave my face stripped and dry after using it. Instead, it actually feels hydrated! I'm definitely going to buy another bottle once out.

avis.titre: A gentle cleanser with a scent
avis.texte: I usually double cleanse with a cleansing balm so I can't speak to this product's ability remove makeup by itself. Otherwise, I would say this is a nice gentle cleanser. I disagree with the "hydrating" description but it's not overly drying. It has a cream to foam consistency. It does have a floral fragrance that I am not a fan of but it doesn't seem to irritate my skin.
I always love Charlotte tilbury and was excited to try their new line of products. Its a light weight cleanser but didn't any difference it made to my face.
A cleanser is a cleanser. Not super impressed with this, but it gets the job done. Cheaper alternatives can be found that do just as well. Overall it's okay.
My skin is clear and my texture has improved the scent is bearable and packaging is very nice it's easy to use. I will recommend to people. My texture and black heads have improved.
I was extremely happy to receive this item from Influenster. Charlotte tilbury is the best brand and I love trying new cleansers and this one was perfect foam

avis.titre: Made my face feel like it was burning.
avis.texte: I was not a fan of this face wash. I attempted to use it multiple times and it made my face feel like it was burning, caused increased redness, and irritation. I had to stop using it to prevent more damage.

While this is marketed as hydrating, I found it anything but. After using my skin felt stripped and very tight, which is not what you want in a cleanser. It could be my skin being especially dry, but a product being marketed as hydrating shouldn't dry anyone out

I received the Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte's Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser in exchange for my honest review. This cream to foam to milk cleanser truly feels magical. It removed my makeup quickly and effectively but didn't leave my skin feeling dry or stripped. My skin feels softer and smoother after continued use. This is a great cleanser, particularly for people with dry skin.
This cleanser takes off all my makeup and hydrates my skin and isn't drying at all! It has a pleasant scent and the packaging is very beautiful. Definitely recommend it.
I like packing, it is so cool, ghe texture is ok and foamy with water. I checked ingridients and they are not perfect, but ok . Scent is nice and it smells tasty. Like it

Lately every cleanser I've been using has been over drying my skin, even the ones that claim they will not "over dry". I have to say this cleanser did not give me that "tight", dry face after using it. My skin felt nice and clean. The scent reminds me of the "Nivea" products. I would definitely recommend

Charlotte's Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser is amazing!! It starts as cream, then turns to foam, and then to "milk"! It's super hydrating, and it leave my face feeling refreshed. I'm still waiting for my pores to shrink, but I'm confident that with continuous use I'll see the results I'm hoping for! My skin has never felt so soft! It washes away makeup, imperfections (and insecurities 😜)

This concert was pretty nice. It does have that classic skin care cleanser smell to it but you can definitely get past that since the packaging is super easy to use and it's very high-quality. I will be repurchasing! ￼

avis.titre: Will never go back to my old product
avis.texte: I am somewhat skeptical trying new cleansers as my face always breaks out. But I gave this a try and was shocked when I woke up with no blemishes. My face felt so much better after using this. The ingredients are gentle but effective. No strong scent. Plus the box was super pretty.

This facial cleanser from Charlotte Tilbury is incredibly luxurious. It has a gentle, pleasant fragrance. It creates a rich lather and leaves my face feeling hydrated, soft and smooth, and well nourished. Very impressed!

I'm so grateful to have received this for free in exchange for my honest review. Never in my life have I thought a facial soap could be so effective, but I suppose that's why magic is in the name of the product. Even after my first use, I noticed that my skin was softer and smoother. After using it for over a month, my skin continued to feel soft and looks great. My makeup applies more smoothly, and my skin looks fresher. I would have never imagined actually liking a cleanser so much, or even considering paying such a hefty price for a cleanser, but I am definitely adding this to my routine.
I really liked how easy is to remove my makeup with this product and it leaves my skin super soft. The packaging is super cute and elegant like all Charlotte tilbury products.
Excellent quality product, does not harm or irritate my skin, excellent duration and excellent consistency… I feel my skin very hydrated……..

avis.titre: Nice cleanser but don't love the scent
avis.texte: This cleanser is nice! I don't love the scent, I'm not sure how to describe it. Not terrible but I'm not a huge fan. Otherwise a great cleanser, and really make my face feel fresh and clean!

This burned my skin around my cheeks where I have sensitivity. It has a heavy scent that gave me a headache. It is milky then foaming when you get it going. There are so many ingredients and too many in my opinion. It feels like makeup rather than skincare and clean.

Definitely used for people with dry skin I have oily and dry skin but i feel like this won't be a good thing to use in the summer unless it's for night time routine so your skin can repair itself at night

Intriguing is my first impression of this magic cleanser. It's supposed to transform from a cream consistency to foam when lathering and then to a milky texture at the end of your cleansing cycle. This allows it to effectively break down all of the dirt and impurities, including everyday light makeup, while hydrating the skin afterwards. My skin indeed feels much more comfortable, even if I'm not applying moisturizer right away. It does have a slight fragrance to it, but I'm not too concerned since it only means to be washed away and not leave for a long time on your skin. I will definitely continue using it to see if it helps with my pores and skin complexion.

I used this one night as a double cleanse after taking off my makeup and I was not impressed. My skin felt greasy and there was still plenty of makeup in my pores. The packaging is cute and the scent is fine, I'm just not sure on its effectiveness. This may be better as a daily cleanser for dry skin.
Great cleanser, left skin clean and moisturized. Great lather too, not much needed. Would recommend to dry skin or sensitive skin. Will buy again!

Great cleanser for your face to help get rid of daily dirt that your face accumulates. My face is a lot smoother since I've started using this! Thank you for selecting me for this campaign to try this product in exchange for my review.

The way Charlotte Tilbury calls this Hydration Revival Cleanser magic—she knew what she was doing. To transform to three different forms and the science behind it is very interesting. I love the feeling it leaves my face in post-cleaning.

avis.titre: Good to hydrate my skin but…
avis.texte: After using this cleanser for a few weeks I found that it does an amazing job with hydrating my skin. It has been a great asset for my skin care routine during the end of the winter season since has prevent my skin from dryness when I clean it up. Even though the formula lathers very well I deducted one star because the cleanser by itself isn't enough to remove all the makeup on my face. Overall it's a great product but it won't be my primary cleanser since I need something to completely remove all the dirt and makeup on my face.

Charlotte Tilbury's Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser is a triple-action skincare miracle! With three transformative textures and expertly blended ingredients like Hyaluronic Acid and Peptides, it cleanses, hydrates, and promotes a radiant glow in one easy step. Skin is immediately revitalized, staying hydrated for up to 24 hours. It's a must-have for effortless skincare that delivers visible results!
Another amazing product from Charlotte Tilbury - a non drying perfect everyday cleanser. It's so easy to use and you need a minimal amount for it to work. It foams easily. It also smells amazing!
Great cleanser from an amazing brand! Perfect for preparing your skin for your daily makeup routine. Absorbs really well and doesn't leave your skin oily or sticky!
I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. This cleanser does a great job at removing makeup and impurities while keeping your skin hydrated.

Absolutely love this cleanser! It has a great consistency that lathers nicely and is super gentle on my skin. My skin looks and feels great after I use this cleanser. I will definitely be getting this product again in the future.

I was skeptical about this product at first. Typically products like this dry out my skin and strip my natural oils, but this one was surprisingly hydrating. I used it as my second cleanser after a cleansing balm. I don't think it would remove all makeup on its own, but it's great as a second cleanser.
I absolutely adore this product. My skin feels amazing after using it My pores are minimized. It removes makeup easily without feeling aggressive on my skin. My skin is soft and buttery after use.

It comes in a beautiful tube packaging that is easy to use. The texture is very silky to begin with and then emulsifies into foam and milky consistency. It is not stripping so it can work well for some folks. For me, the deal breaker was the strong fragrance. I get migraines and have sensitive skin and the fragrance in this was so strong that it triggered both so it is a no for me..

It's a good cleanser that feels nice on the skin and doesn't leave a residue. It does have kind of a dusty scent to it that I don't like in skincare, not sure what it is. It does what it's supposed to, but at this price point I wouldn't purchase without a sale.
I enjoyed this product especially with my sensitive skin. Smells very light and airy. Using in conjunction with charlotte's magic cream was perfect and left my skin feeling great and clean.

I'm so in love with this face wash! It's everything I have ever wanted in one! It does not get to sudsy! It removes my makeup, even stubborn mascara! Feels so good on the skin. My face feels clean after using it, but not tight! It's a good product.

I love how this cleanser removed all my makeup and impurities without drying out my skin. I used it on my trip to Indiana and it was so cold so my skin was extra dry. However, this cleanser didn't make my skin feel tight or stripped at all.

This cleanser comes out like a cream but as you're using it it foams up and then turns into a milky substance. It has hyaluronic acid and peptides. It's vegan and free of all harsh chemicals and ingredients so it's super gentle on the skin. It does have the slightest of fragrance but it says it's less than one percent synthetic. So while there is a slight scent it's not going to irritate your skin if it's sensitive. While using this it completely removes not just my foundation but also my eye makeup well. It leaves my face looking clear, smooth, glowing and plump! I really love how soft my face feels after using this and will definitely make it a staple in my skin care routine.

My face literally had a glow right after using! Honestly a little goes a long way, it really foamed up once I started working it into my face. Was definitely gentle to the touch. Will definitely keep incorporating into my skincare routine!
